content.user_title: Map Conversion Values for Profit Bidding
content.value_statement: Value-based ad bidding can chase revenue or order count when conversion values ignore margin and proxy actions. This skill builds a margin-aware value model and checks it before launch.
actual_capabilities: Defines per-conversion value rules for revenue and non-revenue actions.
Maps revenue to margin-adjusted value using COGS or margin inputs.
Derives proxy values for leads, calls, signups, and similar actions.
Chooses static or dynamic value rules based on the available data.
Runs a value-vs-count reconciliation against recent business results.
Produces a launch-readiness summary for value-based bidding.
limitations: Requires user-provided GA4, ecommerce, margin, or close-rate data.
Does not verify whether conversion tags fire correctly.
Does not resolve cross-platform attribution or duplicate order credit.
Does not call ad-platform APIs unless the host provides approved connectors.

use_cases.title: Prepare tROAS Launch Values
use_cases.description: Build a margin-aware conversion value model before switching campaigns to tROAS bidding.

use_cases.title: Normalize Ecommerce Margin Signals
use_cases.description: Convert purchase revenue into contribution value when product margins vary by SKU or category.

use_cases.title: Price Non-Revenue Conversions
use_cases.description: Assign defensible proxy values to leads, calls, and signups using downstream close rates.

prompt_templates.title: Set Up Basic Values
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup with known purchase values.
prompt_templates.prompt: Map my purchase conversion values for tROAS. I have GA4 purchase value data and a blended margin rate.

prompt_templates.title: Add Lead Proxy Values
prompt_templates.prompt: Build proxy values for leads, phone calls, and signups. I can provide close rate and average order value assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Margin-Based Bidding
prompt_templates.scenario: Campaigns already bid to value but margins differ.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review whether my current conversion values make tROAS optimize toward profit. My margins vary by product category.

prompt_templates.title: Reconcile Value Before Scaling
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced pre-launch QA before budget increase.
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare platform conversion value against booked contribution profit for the last 30 days and list launch blockers.

output_examples.input: Purchase revenue is available, but margin differs by category.
output_examples.output: The output explains which value source to use, how to apply margin, and which rows need better COGS data.

output_examples.input: Lead and phone-call conversions have no direct revenue.
output_examples.output: The output shows proxy value derivations from close rate and average net order value, with missing inputs clearly marked.

output_examples.input: Platform value totals are much higher than booked contribution profit.
output_examples.output: The output flags the mismatch, names likely causes, and states whether value-based bidding is launch-ready.

best_practices: Provide recent GA4 purchase value, order margin, and COGS exports before asking for the model.
Label every value as measured, user-provided, estimated, or needing input.
Run conversion-signal QA before relying on the value model for bidding.
anti_patterns: Do not use round proxy values without close-rate or order-value support.
Do not optimize to gross revenue when margins vary materially.
Do not treat cross-platform attribution gaps as value-model fixes.

faq.question: What data should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide conversion actions, bid goal, GA4 purchase value, order revenue, COGS, margin, and close-rate inputs when available.

faq.question: Can it work with only blended margin?
faq.answer: Yes. It can apply a blended margin, but it will label the result as estimated and note the risk.

faq.question: Does it check tracking setup?
faq.answer: No. It assumes conversion events can be measured and routes tag or UTM checks to conversion-signal QA.

faq.question: Does it handle lead generation accounts?
faq.answer: Yes. It derives proxy values for leads, calls, signups, or similar actions from downstream economics.

faq.question: Can it choose static or dynamic values?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares the data shape and recommends static values, dynamic values, or value rules.

faq.question: Will it save results automatically?
faq.answer: No. The skill asks before writing value-model notes to memory files.
